title: How the Daily Price Written onto a Keyturn Vehicle Listing Is Worked Out
content:
The daily price a Keyturn Vehicle Listing carries is set within the floor and the ceiling of the value band the listing sits in, and the figure the marketplace writes is worked out before the price is changed.

The band a listing is read against is the entry band, whose ceiling is 95.00 USD a day and whose floor is 22.00 USD a day.

The figure the marketplace starts from is the price the host is asking for the vehicle at the handling date, carried forward as it stands. That carried figure is then taken through the share of the band the vehicle's cover standing leaves open to it, the share being applied once and the product rounded half away from zero to two decimal places. The share of the band open to a listing is the whole band, expressed as 1.

A price may not fall in one day by more than the movement rate, which is fifteen hundredths (0.15) of the price asked, so the price asked less that movement is worked out, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places, and the greater of it and the figure reached in the previous step is taken.

The figure so taken is finally brought inside the band, being held to the ceiling where it stands above it and lifted to the floor where it stands below it, and the result is rounded half away from zero to two decimal places.

### Worked through on hypothetical records

*A price asked of 80.00 USD a day.* Carried forward it stands at 80.00 USD. Taken through the share of the band open to it, 1, it stands at 80.00 USD. The price asked less fifteen hundredths of itself is 68.00 USD, and the greater of 68.00 USD and 80.00 USD is 80.00 USD. That figure is inside the band, above the floor of 22.00 USD and below the ceiling of 95.00 USD, so 80.00 USD is written.

*A price asked of 120.00 USD a day.* Carried forward and taken through the share it stands at 120.00 USD; the price asked less fifteen hundredths of itself is 102.00 USD, and the greater of the two is 120.00 USD. Brought inside the band it is held to the ceiling, so 95.00 USD is written.

*A price asked of 20.00 USD a day.* Carried forward and taken through the share it stands at 20.00 USD; the price asked less fifteen hundredths of itself is 17.00 USD, and the greater of the two is 20.00 USD. Brought inside the band it is lifted to the floor, so 22.00 USD is written.
